sections.h2: Is India expensive to visit? It depends on six choices
sections.lead: India can be a modest or a lavish trip. These are the choices that move the total most — ask us to price two versions side by side.
items: Season

October to March is the peak season for Delhi, Agra and Rajasthan, so book early. The UK FCDO notes the monsoon usually runs from June to October — fewer visitors, but rain and landslides in the hills. See the best time to visit India.
Number of days
Every extra day adds a hotel night and a day of car and driver. Our routes run from 4 to 12 days; longer trips are quoted on request.
Hotel level
Our “from” prices use comfortable 3-star hotels. 4-star, 5-star and heritage palace hotels cost more — we quote them in US dollars.
How many of you
Prices are per person for two sharing a room. Solo travellers and families get their own quote.
Car or train

Most of our trips use your own car. Some legs work well by train: foreign tourists can reserve seats up to 365 days ahead under the Foreign Tourist Quota (the general window is 60 days). Compare in trains vs flights in India.
Festivals and big dates
Big festivals such as Holi and Diwali are busy times. Plan around them with our India festivals calendar.

sections.h2: The fixed costs outside any tour: visa, insurance and tickets
sections.lead: These you pay yourself, whoever you travel with.
items: e-Visa fee

The fee depends on your nationality and the visa length, and for the 30-day e-Tourist visa it is lower for April–June arrivals than July–March. The official fee table on indianvisaonline.gov.in lists it; a small bank charge is added, the fee is non-refundable and there is no express fee. Pay the e-Visa fee only on indianvisaonline.gov.in — look-alike sites charge extra. We are not a visa agency. Step by step: our India e-Visa guide.
Travel insurance

The US CDC describes three kinds: travel disruption, travel health and medical evacuation — and notes that an evacuation can be very expensive. The US State Department says Medicare and Medicaid don't pay for care abroad. We don't sell insurance and this is not advice — compare policies yourself; see CDC/NHS Fit for Travel. More in our India travel insurance guide.
Monument tickets
At the Taj Mahal and Humayun's Tomb, foreign visitors buy a separate, higher ticket than Indian visitors; prices are on the official sites. The Taj Mahal is closed on Fridays.
Money on the ground
Cash, cards and UPI — how visitors can pay day to day: UPI and money in India.

faqs: How much does a 2-week trip to India cost?

With us, a private 12-day trip — the Golden Triangle plus Shimla and Manali — starts from US$1,099 per person, two sharing, with car, driver and 3-star hotels with breakfast. Add your international flights, the e-Visa fee, travel insurance, monument tickets and meals not listed. Two full weeks are quoted on request.

It depends on your choices more than on India itself: the season (October to March is peak), the number of days, the hotel level, how many of you share, car or train, and festival dates. Ask us to price two versions side by side.
What is included in your tour price?

A private air-conditioned car and driver, comfortable 3-star hotels with daily breakfast (two sharing) and the sightseeing plan of the route; local guides on the classic 6-day Golden Triangle. Your written quote lists everything before you pay.
What costs extra on an India trip?
International flights, your e-Visa fee, travel insurance, monument tickets unless your quote lists them, meals other than breakfast, tips and shopping.
How much is the Indian e-Visa?

It depends on your nationality and the visa length; the 30-day e-Tourist visa is cheaper for April–June arrivals than July–March. The official fee table is on indianvisaonline.gov.in. Pay the e-Visa fee only on indianvisaonline.gov.in — look-alike sites charge extra.
Do foreigners pay more for monuments in India?
Yes. At sites such as the Taj Mahal and Humayun's Tomb, foreign visitors buy a separate, higher ticket than Indian visitors. The Taj Mahal is closed on Fridays.
When is India cheapest to visit?

Outside the October–March peak hotels are easier to find, but the monsoon usually runs from June to October, bringing rain and landslides in the hills. Tell us your dates and we will say honestly what to expect.
How do I pay for my trip?

A 20% deposit locks your dates and price; the deposit is fully refunded if you cancel within 48 hours of paying; the balance is due before the trip. Pay by card through Razorpay (international cards accepted) or by PayPal.
